title: Units of measure: decide which writes the unit membership check judges (ADR-0158 Open item 9)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Routed by [ADR-0158](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0158-units-of-measure-standard-unit-table-org-units-quantity-unit-declaration-base-quantity.md#open-items), Open item 9, to the membership card (R1, U5). Parent: #35339 (ADR merged in PR #35370, 35bd36082c).

## Question (the ADR's text)
Which writes U5 judges, for three cases: a code written; a quantity written beside a resting code that is no longer a member (an org unit deleted under L1); a quantity written beside a blank code. The two precedents differ: the record validator judges a `valueDomain` on the written value only (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`); the currency pair guard judges only touched pairs, and only for a blank code (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts`). Under either, a quantity update on a row whose stored code is no longer a member passes, while L1 refuses "a new save with that code". A third shape (membership of the row image's code whenever the pair is touched) closes that, but it also refuses a quantity edit on every row still holding free text before the backfill runs, so it orders R1's rollout. Also open: whether a quantity may rest beside a blank unit (ADR-0144 D8 rule 4 refuses an amount beside a blank currency code), and whether U5 checks a code's dimension against the field's `unitDimension`.

## Done when
The membership card states the judged writes for all three cases, the blank-unit rule and the dimension check, with the R1 rollout order the choice implies; ADR-0158 is amended.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:server. First R1 member; decides whether L1's delete refusal is actually enforced.
